_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Eighteen source-backed adults in historical Russian drug cases. First-instance outcomes are expressly labelled where appeal finality is unconfirmed; prior overturned judgments are reconciled. RUS marks historical conduct, never current location. No direct person links, operational routes, or portraits.

sources.title: Кассационное определение Верховного Суда РФ от 17.09.2024 № 71-УД24-3-А1
sources.publisher: Supreme Court of the Russian Federation via Legalacts
sources.claim: The Russian Supreme Court left in force the 2023 drug-smuggling and intended-sale judgment against Николай Викторович Зарубанов, including a 22 years aggregate sentence. An earlier 2022 judgment had been set aside for a defense-rights procedure issue and retried; the 2023 judgment was affirmed on appeal and cassation.

legalHistory.qualifier: Earlier first-instance judgment set aside for a defense-rights procedural issue; case remitted for retrial. This did not acquit the defendant.
